# Rho Lall — BI Architect

> Rho Lall is a BI Architect offering a free, code-first governance diagnostic
> for growing data environments. It evaluates six areas (definitions,
> architecture, reporting, ownership, institutional memory, change risk) and
> identifies the 2–3 issues worth tackling first.
